title: Void Particles
description: Adds the void fog & particles removed in Minecraft 1.8
body:
# Minecraft's unOfficial Void Particles
This datapack brings back the void fog from Minecraft 1.8

When a player crosses Y=-47, the fog of the void will begin to cover their vision; and when crossing Y=-59, the player will suffer Blindness, as they get very close to the edge of the world.

This datapack executes the commands (particles & blindness) for each player  within the area of ​​effect (Y=-47 downwards). This could cause performance issues when multiple players are in the area of ​​effect.

To learn the basic commands of this datapack, the operator should use the following command:
`/function void_fog:help`

This data pack belongs to the [Minecraft unOfficial Project](https://modrinth.com/collection/hB55ZXtF).
